status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED_VERIFIED: The section's reusable mechanism is present and has current, inspectable verification. It is not a claim of professional generalization.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Some relevant mechanism or evidence exists, but the directive's full behavioral requirement remains unproven.
status_definitions.EXTERNAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Further progress depends on an explicit human or external review rather than an agent assumption.
status_definitions.DEFERRED_BY_PRIORITY: The work is intentionally postponed by the live priority rule and is not represented as complete.

requirements.title: Mission
requirements.current_boundary: The typed loop and evidence infrastructure exist, but unseen-reference professional modeling has not been demonstrated repeatedly.
requirements.next_step: Complete a human-authorized Level-1 reference prop through independent review and retain the correction trail.

requirements.title: Precedence and scope
requirements.current_boundary: This verifies the repository policy and its documentation cross-references, not future operator compliance.
requirements.next_step: Apply the precedence check during each substantive session and reconcile new contradictory evidence.

requirements.title: Session start
requirements.current_boundary: The checklist and repository audit are available; a live Blender connection is only inspected when the task needs one.
requirements.next_step: Record live Blender identity and state before the next authorized scene mutation.

requirements.title: Professional modeling judgment
requirements.current_boundary: The C38 correction and Type 75 benchmark now use crease-controlled box cages, connected revolved profile cages, and small bevels only for evidenced physical radii. This is broader real-asset use, but the lamp has no human visual acceptance and does not establish professional generalization.
requirements.next_step: Use independent visual feedback to classify and repair the Type 75 rather than promoting its technical pass as artistic success.

requirements.title: Modeling stages
requirements.current_boundary: The state machine and evidence gate are verified in controlled work; artistic stage judgment remains partial under Section 4.
requirements.next_step: Use the gate for the next human-authorized reference-modeling run.

requirements.title: Component and strategy planning
requirements.current_boundary: C38 has a qualified stage pass and the Type 75 applies an explicit physical-assembly graph: connected formed shells, connected box-derived bars, and separate real pivots/springs. Type 75 component fidelity remains unreviewed by a human.
requirements.next_step: Compare the Type 75 linkage and shade mount against the official views and localize any human-reported mismatch.

requirements.title: Planner contract
requirements.current_boundary: The Type 75 run follows a recorded component/construction/stage plan through typed revision-owned decisions, but repeated adaptive planner use after visual rejection is still sparse.
requirements.next_step: Retain any Type 75 repair as an explicit observed-mismatch, local decision, and re-render cycle.

requirements.title: Closed-loop execution
requirements.current_boundary: The Type 75 was observed and re-rendered across primary-envelope, linkage/SubD, and secondary-component stages; one silent render-error path was found and repaired. Artistic adequacy still lacks independent visual confirmation.
requirements.next_step: Continue the same observe-diagnose-decide-verify loop for any reference mismatch found in review.

requirements.title: State authority and recovery
requirements.current_boundary: State/rollback behavior is verified for the tested operation surface, not every arbitrary Blender edit.
requirements.next_step: Extend coverage only when a new sanctioned operation needs additional state fidelity.

requirements.title: Persistent geometry and semantics
requirements.current_boundary: Identity and semantic regions cover the tested operations. Connected profile revolution now assigns persistent IDs immediately, and partial crease values such as 0.82 remain explicit intent instead of being silently discarded.
requirements.next_step: Add operation-specific tests only when newly sanctioned operations require them.

requirements.title: Separate truth channels
requirements.current_boundary: Base/evaluated/visual/technical channels are available, but their outputs still require informed interpretation.
requirements.next_step: Use all relevant channels in the next asset review rather than treating a technical pass as visual approval.

requirements.title: Reference modeling and perception
requirements.current_boundary: The Type 75 adds a manufacturer-authored multi-pose package, official dimensions, explicit hidden-detail constraints, and controlled side/front/isometric review views. Machine readiness and technical structure pass; human reference resemblance remains unproven.
requirements.next_step: Use visual review to localize Type 75 silhouette/linkage mismatches before any production-detail claim.

requirements.title: Research and knowledge lifecycle
requirements.current_boundary: Source observation, bounded episode review, two-family UV transfer, principal-axis Image Empty transfer, and two-family explicit bevel-intent transfer exist; later timestamp drift and visual failure controls are retained, while real-asset runtime use and long-horizon skill reuse remain incomplete.
requirements.next_step: Promote only techniques that are reproduced, transferred, and then used on an authorized asset.

requirements.title: Controlled experiments and retrieval
requirements.current_boundary: Controlled labs, 23 retrieval positive/abstention cases, two bounded lesson transfers, explicit sharp-edge completeness transfer, strict all-quad curved Connect Vertex Path transfer, and a structurally validated five-day fresh-scenario quiz exist; factual independence, week-scale retention, and broader real-asset transfer remain open.
requirements.next_step: Obtain an independent delayed assessment and reuse validated knowledge on a fresh human-authorized asset.

requirements.title: Quality and completion
requirements.current_boundary: Production high/low packaging, seam-directed UV transfer, bakes, exports, and quality checks are demonstrated across controlled cases. The Type 75 has 21 independently editable high/low pairs with live modifiers in separate collections, but its lows are explicitly editable low-SubD variants and the asset is not reviewer-accepted production work.
requirements.next_step: Apply the complete quality checklist to an approved prop and preserve live, unapplied modifier stacks.

requirements.title: Evaluation and anti-fake-progress rules
requirements.current_boundary: The project preserves explicit rejections and rejects automated-only success, but lacks enough accepted held-out assets for a capability claim.
requirements.next_step: Keep thresholds frozen before new benchmarks and seek independent visual acceptance after technical checks.

requirements.title: Reporting
requirements.current_boundary: Report structure and evidence navigation exist; individual reports remain limited to what was actually measured.
requirements.next_step: Update the field report only with verified current evidence after each substantive session.

requirements.title: Tool architecture: Cloudglue and the Blender Connector (2026-08-13)
requirements.current_boundary: Portable local ingestion and native range-scoped Gemini analysis are implemented with identity, absolute-time, and independent-review controls; TubeAlfred and other optional connectors are not available or assumed authoritative in this environment.
requirements.next_step: Use connector output only as source observation and formalize any mutation needed for evidence through the typed runtime.

requirements.title: Continuation directive reconciliation (2026-08-14)
requirements.current_boundary: The directive's Level-1-first correction is adopted; advanced curriculum and sculpt specialization remain intentionally deferred.
requirements.next_step: Build breadth across simple, structurally distinct authorized props before returning to Level-5-plus complexity.

requirements.title: Current development rule
requirements.current_boundary: The live priorities identify reference interpretation and reviewer-approved Level-1 breadth as the bottleneck; this has not yet been resolved.
requirements.next_step: Do not substitute additional infrastructure or passive tutorial collection for the pending reference-modeling proof.
